title: Oura Ring button
description: A soft, fully round 48px pill with a 16px label: warm dark grey (the default), electric blue for the one main CTA, or cream on dark bands. Also a 45px round arrow button, filled or bare. Darkens on hover in 0.15s.
notes: tone solid = primary, blue = highlight, inverse = foreground on background (meant for dark-scoped bands)
hover darkens with a brightness filter, so it works for any theme colour
